text:
Maya: opened a small PR to refresh the "hello world" quickstart for SDK v5 auth helpers. goal: reduce copy-paste friction for first deploys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4189 :sparkles:
Sam: thanks! quick glance found a mismatch in the bash export example vs the python env var name. can you paste the snippets inline?
Maya: sure, current bash snippet in the draft:
```bash
export API_KEY=sk-xxxx
redwood deploy --app hello-world
```
Maya: and python sample was reading REDWOOD_API_KEY, so that caused confusion for some reviewers.
Jin: let's standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY across all quickstarts (CLI, SDK, curl). it's clearer and avoids collisions. also add a one-line on Windows setx.
Ashley: small UX thing: the curl example prints a raw JSON body. new users get overwhelmed by the output. suggest using jq to pretty print or show only the text field: `curl ... | jq -r .text`
Maya: good idea, added a curl pipe to jq and replaced export var with REDWOOD_API_KEY. also added a short note: "If you get a 401, check env var name and run `echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY`".
Kai: fyi I added a flaky check in docs CI that runs the quickstart against staging keys. caught an intermittent DNS timeout when the staging edge was under load. increased timeout in the harness and retried.
Sam: running snippet-lint now. also can we avoid hardcoding `--region=us-west-2` in the CLI example? that confuses users on hosted plan. Recommend: omit region or mark as optional.
Maya: removed the region flag and added an aside: "Optional: add --region for Dedicated/private deployments." Pushed commit.
Leo: can we put a "next steps" pointer at the end linking to the Dedicated capacity and Private deployment pages? new customers usually ask about latency guarantees after first deploy.
Maya: added two links under Next steps. kept it brief.
Jin: left one inline comment to clarify rate-limit headers in the curl output. otherwise LGTM.
Sam: snippet-lint and markdown-link-check passed. smoke-e2e failed first try due to the staging timeout Kai mentioned, retried and passed.
Maya: thanks! I'll follow up with a tiny PR to add Windows examples (powershell) and a checklist for first deploy troubleshooting (timeouts, 401s, CORS).
Ashley: happy to draft the powershell snippets.
DocsBot: PR #4189 merged by DocsBot and published to staging site (build docs-2026-03-23-99). :rocket:
